title: IBM Security QRadar EDR 3.12 through 3.12.26 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security…
description: IBM Security QRadar EDR versions 3.12 through 3.12.26 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper rate limiting on TOTP verification. This flaw could enable attackers with valid credentials to circumvent multi-factor authentication protections.
